nodes.description: BotProtected.owner: address of contract owner, set to tx.origin in CamelCoin constructor and used for privileged access checks in delegate/distribute/list.
BotProtected.protectionFromBots: external oracle address invoked via low-level call inside checkBots modifier.
BotProtected.uniPair: computed Uniswap pair address passed to the bot-protection oracle.
CamelCoin.balanceOf: mapping of holder balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/distribute/list.
CamelCoin.allowance: nested mapping of approvals, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
CamelCoin.totalSupply: initial supply 5e24 used to size owner allocation in list().
CamelCoin.routerForPancake: hardcoded UniswapV2-style router used for addLiquidityETH liquidity call.
CamelCoin.wrappedEther: WETH address used to derive the pair address in the constructor.
CamelCoin.decimals: constant token decimals value (18).
CamelCoin.name: token name string 'Camel Coin'.
CamelCoin.symbol: token symbol string 'CAMEL'.
ERC20._balances: private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract (unused by CamelCoin).
ERC20._allowances: private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
ERC20._totalSupply: private total supply of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
BotProtected constructor: assigns the external bot-protection oracle address.
checkBots modifier: performs an unchecked low-level call to protectionFromBots and requires success before the modified body runs.
CamelCoin constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, derives uniPair and grants unlimited allowances to the router and the pair.
CamelCoin.transfer: payable wrapper that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom.
CamelCoin.transferFrom: guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
CamelCoin.approve: writable payable approval that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without checks.
CamelCoin.delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address and calldata.
pairForUniswap: pure address derivation of the Uniswap pair via CREATE2 keccak hash.
CamelCoin.distribute: owner-only mass balance overwrite with an embedded low-level oracle call.
CamelCoin.list: owner-only liquidity listing that overwrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a block.timestamp deadline, and mass-assigns balances.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used by the abstract ERC20 implementation.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used by the abstract ERC20 implementation.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div: division with explicit zero check.
ERC20.transfer: base implementation forwarding msg.sender to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom: base implementation that moves balances and decreases allowance via SafeMath.
ERC20._transfer: internal balance mutation guarded by SafeMath.
ERC20._approve: internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for allowance checks, approvals and owner gates.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in list().
tx.origin: used as the owner identity and allowance beneficiary in the CamelCoin constructor.
Low-level protectionFromBots.call(0x15274141,...) inside checkBots executed before any state change in transferFrom.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) allowing the owner to execute external code in this contract's storage context.
routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value} external value transfer executed before final balance writes.
Low-level protectionFromBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3,...) inside distribute before the balance overwrite loop.
Low-level protectionFromBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3,...) inside list before the balance assignment loop.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath on Solidity 0.7.0.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing supply inflation on overflow.
Constructor parameter _botProtection supplying the external oracle address.
transferFrom parameter _from: debited account.
transferFrom parameter _to: credited account.
transferFrom parameter _value: transfer amount used in arithmetic and oracle call.
approve parameter _spender: approval target.
delegate parameter a: arbitrary address targeted by delegatecall.
delegate parameter b: arbitrary calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
pairForUniswap parameter tokenA.
pairForUniswap parameter tokenB.
_toAddresses array of recipients in distribute and list.
amount assigned to every recipient in distribute.
_numList token amount supplied to addLiquidityETH and contract balance in list.
_amounts array of per-recipient amounts in list.
Loop counter i used in the distribute and list balance assignment loops.
success flag returned from the delegatecall in delegate.
notABot boolean returned from the oracle low-level call in checkBots.
pair address computed in pairForUniswap and stored into uniPair.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in transferFrom to decide whether an allowance must be spent, controlling authorization.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
tx.origin is written into owner in the constructor, making ownership spoofable via phishing.
block.timestamp plus 600 is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline, introducing miner-controllable timing.
totalSupply determines the owner allocation (totalSupply * 6 / 100) in list.
balanceOf is read and mutated unchecked inside transferFrom.
allowance is read and decremented unchecked inside transferFrom.
routerForPancake is the external contract invoked by list via addLiquidityETH.
wrappedEther is used with address(this) to derive uniPair in the constructor.
uniPair is encoded into the oracle calldata of the checkBots modifier.
protectionFromBots is the call target of the low-level call in checkBots.
owner equality check gates the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
owner equality check gates the arbitrary balance overwrite in distribute.
owner equality check gates balance overwrite and liquidity provision in list.
checkBots modifier wraps and precedes the transferFrom body.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
CamelCoin constructor calls pairForUniswap to compute uniPair.
ERC20.transfer invokes the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom decreases allowance through _approve.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
ERC20.transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
checkBots modifier body executes the low-level oracle call.
delegate executes the a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation.
list performs the external addLiquidityETH value call.
distribute performs the low-level oracle call before the assignment loop.
list performs the low-level oracle call before the assignment loop.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without overflow/underflow protection.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath, permitting mint-on-overflow.
External oracle call in checkBots runs before transferFrom updates balances, enabling reentrant transferFrom.
addLiquidityETH hands control to the router before the recipient balance loop completes in list.
delegatecall gives the callee full control over the caller's storage and state.
Low-level oracle call in distribute can re-enter the contract before balances are rewritten.
Low-level oracle call in list precedes the balance assignment loop, allowing reentrancy.
_botProtection initializes protectionFromBots in the BotProtected constructor.
_from is the debited account argument of transferFrom.
_to is the credited account argument of transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount argument of transferFrom.
_spender is the approval target argument of approve.
parameter a selects the delegatecall target address.
parameter b supplies the delegatecall payload.
tokenA is one of the pair tokens hashed in pairForUniswap.
tokenB is one of the pair tokens hashed in pairForUniswap.
_toAddresses lists the recipients overwritten in distribute.
amount is written to every recipient balance in distribute.
_numList sets the contract balance and the addLiquidityETH token amount in list.
_amounts holds per-recipient values assigned in the list loop.
loop index i drives the balance assignment loop in list.
success captures the boolean result of the delegatecall.
notABot captures the boolean result of the oracle low-level call in checkBots.
pair is the CREATE2-derived address returned by pairForUniswap.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection directly initializes the protectionFromBots state variable in the BotProtected constructor.
_from is only meaningful as the debited account argument of transferFrom and should be folded into that function.
_to is only meaningful as the credited account argument of transferFrom.
_value is only meaningful as the amount argument of transferFrom and its unchecked arithmetic.
_spender is only meaningful as the approval target of approve.
parameter a is the direct target operand of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
parameter b is the direct calldata operand of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
tokenA is only used inside pairForUniswap for the pair hash.
tokenB is only used inside pairForUniswap for the pair hash.
_toAddresses is the recipient list consumed by the distribute balance loop.
amount is the fixed value written to every recipient by distribute.
_numList parameterizes the liquidity amount and contract balance in list.
_amounts parameterizes the per-recipient balance writes in list.
loop index i exists only to iterate recipients inside list.
success holds the return status of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
notABot holds the boolean result of the oracle low-level call in the checkBots modifier.
pair is the computed output of pairForUniswap and is immediately stored in uniPair.
